# ankra_alert_destination (Resource)

An alert destination: a webhook URL (Slack, Teams, Discord, PagerDuty or a custom endpoint), or a Slack or Teams channel the Ankra bot posts to. Alerts and notification routes (`ankra_alert_route`) deliver to it. The counterpart of `ankra alerts destinations create|update|delete`. Set exactly one of `url` and `channel_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_alert_destination" "pagerduty" {
  name             = "on-call"
  integration_type = "pagerduty"
  url              = var.pagerduty_events_url
  description      = "Pages the on-call engineer"
}

resource "ankra_alert_destination" "platform_channel" {
  name             = "platform-alerts"
  integration_type = "slack"
  channel_id       = "C0123456789"
  channel_name     = "platform-alerts"
}

variable "pagerduty_events_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Destination name, unique in the organisation.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Slack or Teams channel the Ankra bot posts to, instead of a webhook URL. List the candidates with `ankra alerts destinations channels`.
- `channel_name` (String) Display name of `channel_id`. Only stored alongside a channel.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether alerts are delivered to the destination. Defaults to `true`.
- `integration_type` (String) Receiver kind: `slack`, `teams`, `discord`, `pagerduty` or `custom`. Defaults to `slack`. Changing it replaces the destination.
- `teams_tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Teams tenant of a Teams channel destination; required when `integration_type` is `teams` and `channel_id` is set.
- `template` (String) Payload template; unset uses the platform's default payload for the receiver.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Webhook URL, which usually embeds a secret token. A change made outside Terraform is detected while the platform still returns the URL; a destination whose URL moved to Vault returns none, and then drift is not detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the destination; what `ankra_alert_route.destination_id` references.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Alert destinations are imported by id.
terraform import ankra_alert_destination.pagerduty 3f6d2a52-8a7e-4c1b-9d4e-0b8f6c2e1a90
```
